extraction.document_summary: This brochure from Singlife describes two independently marketed personal accident insurance products with worldwide coverage: Singlife Accident Care (individual cover) and Singlife Family Accident Care (shared family cover). Both are annual renewable plans with accidental death and dismemberment as the core benefit, paying percentage-based amounts tied to the Accidental Death and Dismemberment Benefit (ADDB) schedule, with higher payouts in specified travel/transport/fire scenarios. Base plans also provide cash benefits for hospitalisation (daily cash for up to 365 days per accident), plus services and family-related event/leave compensation options, including a Life Stage Event lump sum paid if the accident occurs within 12 months. For expanded protection, the brochure adds named riders (Accident Reimbursement Cover II, Accidental Fracture Cover III, Weekly Income Cover II) with multiple Plan 1–4 tiers and per-accident/per-policy-year limits.
quality_notes: Includes extensive numeric benefit tables for base plans and rider plan tiers.
Exclusions are referenced generally (“definitions and exclusions”) but no specific excluded events/circumstances are explicitly enumerated in the provided text.
Entry/eligibility details (e.g., occupation class, minimum/maximum entry ages) are only partially stated; many underwriting fields are not explicitly provided.

policies.quick_summary: Annual renewable personal accident insurance with worldwide coverage for accidental death and dismemberment, daily hospitalisation income, and other cash/services benefits; offers Lite/Standard/Plus/Prestige/Pinnacle tiers. Optional riders add medical reimbursement, fracture/dislocation with physiotherapy support, and weekly income for temporary disability (accident and sickness). Rider tier limits are stated per accident and/or per policy year with Plan 1–4 options for each rider category included in the brochure table set-up for this base product (not Family). The brochure states the product has no savings/investment feature and therefore no cash value.

policies.quick_summary: Annual renewable personal accident insurance with worldwide coverage for accidental death and dismemberment, daily hospitalisation cash income, and other cash benefits, designed for families with shared payout limits. It covers a minimum of two and up to six lives under one policy, with one shared Accidental Death and Dismemberment limit across all Lives Assured (claims paid as they come up until the shared limit is reached). Base plan tiers are Standard and Prestige with ADDB per Policy Year of S$500,000 and S$1,000,000 respectively, and different renewal/coverage expiry rules than the individual plan (renewal up to before the Main Life Assured turns age 80). Optional riders add medical reimbursement, fracture/dislocation with physiotherapy, and weekly income for temporary disability, with a separate (Family) rider variant in the brochure tables.
policies.target_customer: Families with shared coverage under one policy; covers minimum of two and up to six family members.
coverage_scope: Worldwide coverage for accidental death or injury
Accidental death and dismemberment for multiple Lives Assured under shared payout limit mechanics
Accidental injury cash benefits and family-related compensation benefits described for the Family product
occupation_classes: Occupation class 1 and 2 (used for premium calculation stated in notes)
policies.eligibility_notes: Family eligibility includes up to 6 family members; up to 2 adult Lives Assured who must be parents; up to 4 dependent child Lives Assured with insurable interest; one Main Life Assured adult who must stay throughout the policy term; renewal up to before Main Life Assured turns age 80 at policy level and coverage expiry age for adult and child Life Assured are 80 and 20 respectively.
policies.coverage_term_description: Yearly renewable; stay covered up to the age of 80 years (main Life Assured) and coverage for each Life Assured ends at Policy Anniversary when reached adult 80 / child 20 coverage expiry age as stated.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Premium payable calculated as total of premiums of all Lives Assured based on ANB at each Policy Anniversary; inclusive of GST and based on annual payment mode; premiums and features may change on renewal.
policies.renewal_basis: Yearly renewable up to Policy Anniversary before Main Life Assured turns age 80, subject to Main Life Assured still covered and at least 2 Lives Assured covered.
policy_termination_events: Policy will be terminated when 150% of the Sum Assured for ADDB is claimed in a Policy Year (note applies to ADDB schedule termination)
important_caveats: Core ADDB payout limit is shared across all Lives Assured under the policy (claims paid as they come up until the limit is reached).
The brochure indicates no savings/investment feature; therefore no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.

benefits.benefit_name: Accidental Death and Dismemberment Benefit (ADDB) - shared family limit
benefits.benefit_description: Shared payout limit across multiple Lives Assured under one policy; applies the ADDB schedule and multipliers described in the brochure notes; policy terminates when 150% of Sum Assured for ADDB is claimed in a Policy Year.
benefits.trigger_description: Accidental death or dismemberment due to an accident.
covered_conditions: Accidental death or dismemberment due to an accident
benefits.payout_basis: ADDB schedule and per-policy-year plan limits; single shared limit
benefits.payout_description: Family plans provide coverage of S$500,000 or S$1 million for ADDB per policy year depending on tier, with payouts according to ADDB Schedule. The brochure states the ADDB payout limit is shared and the policy terminates when 150% of Sum Assured for ADDB is claimed in a Policy Year.
benefits.claim_frequency: shared by all Lives Assured until shared limit reached
benefits.geographic_scope: Worldwide coverage for accidental death or injury (marketing description).
benefits.notes: The brochure provides multipliers (3x for plane/cruise and 2x for public transport/pedestrian/fire) in the notes that apply to ADDB payout scenarios.

benefits.benefit_description: Family version provides the Annual Leave Compensation Benefit for eligible annual leave days taken to care for the Life Assured during eligible hospitalisation following an accident.
benefits.trigger_description: Accidental injury requiring hospitalisation for 4 consecutive days or more and annual leave taken by a parent/spouse/child/sibling from employer to care for Life Assured; paid per day starting from 3rd day; first 2 days excluded.
covered_conditions: Annual leave taken to care for Life Assured during eligible hospitalisation
benefits.payout_description: S$100 per day up to 14 days per accident; not applicable to first 2 days of annual leave taken.
benefits.benefit_start_description: Starts from 3rd day of annual leave.
benefits.notes: Eligibility conditions described in the notes are for Accident Care; brochure states Family has same benefits as Singlife Accident Care with key differences, so this entry captures the shared benefit rules where text is present.

evidence.quote: Get the same benefits as Singlife Accident Care with key differences below.
We will pay the Annual Leave Compensation Benefit for each day of annual leave starting from the 3rd day of annual leave
This benefit is not applicable to the first 2 days of annual leave taken.

benefits.benefit_description: Provides additional lump sum payout for accidental death or Total and Permanent Disability that occurs 12 months from Life Stage Events.
benefits.trigger_description: Life Assured dies or sustains Total and Permanent Disability as a result of an Accident, where the Accident occurs 12 months from the Life Stage Event date (or until termination, whichever earlier).
covered_conditions: Timing condition: Accident occurs 12 months from Life Stage Event date
benefits.payout_basis: per accident (plan table shows amounts for base plan tiers)
benefits.payout_description: Brochure states Life Stage Event Benefit timing and that it pays in one lump sum; amounts are shown in base plan table for the individual product and the Family columns (though not clearly extracted as numeric for both Family tiers in the excerpt).
benefits.notes: Family product description explicitly says it has the same benefits as Accident Care with key differences (including shared payout limit mechanics).

evidence.quote:
Life Stage Event Benefit
Provides additional lump sum payout for accidental death or Total and Permanent Disability
